Name: Shelomith, Daughter of Zerubbabel
Summary: Daughter of Zerubbabel, named as sister of Meshullam and Hananiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:19: Daughter of Zerubbabel, named as sister of Meshullam and Hananiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shelomith stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
